title: Bitcoin And Silver Keep Trading The Lead
source: Total market value of circulating bitcoin vs the world's above-ground investable silver stock at spot price, approximate figures compiled from CoinDesk/CoinMarketCap/The Block/Phemex reporting. Bitcoin passed silver's market cap in March 2024 (~$1.4T) and again in November 2024 (~$1.77T, becoming the 8th-largest asset); silver's 2025 price surge then pushed its own market cap to roughly $6.1T, well back ahead of bitcoin's ~$1.75T, before silver eased to about $3.6T (bitcoin ~$1.7T) by September 2026.
